title: A smooth Reshetnyak-harmonic sphere with unbounded distortion
verdict: No substantive mathematical defect found in the complete published claims as written.

strongest_verified_result: The explicit smooth homeomorphism from the round sphere to the explicit compact smooth Riemannian sphere is a local Reshetnyak minimizer against every same-trace W1,2 competitor in the whole target, has singular-value ratio t^-2 on positive-area central bands and satisfies all stated target hypotheses. Separately, the KS angular-stress argument gives infinitesimal quasiconformality for locally KS-minimizing spheres into complete metric targets in the standard Sobolev framework; both the self-contained nonsharp bound and inherited stronger pointwise bound are justified.
